accessReview.heading: Access review
accessReview.help: Each review lists every member's role grant with its entitlements and last use, grouped by domain. The owner of each domain confirms or revokes each row and says why. A revocation removes the grant at once.
accessReview.scheduleHint: Cron in UTC: minute hour day month weekday. Empty: no scheduled review.
accessReview.noReviews: No review has been taken yet.
accessReview.noRows: No rows in this review for the domains you own.

prompt.revoked: Revoke {{member}}'s {{role}} grant in {{domain}}. It is removed at once.

accessReview.reasonHint: Why you confirm or revoke this access. It is recorded with your decision.
accessReview.webhookUrlHint: Each scheduled review is posted here, signed with the secret. Empty: no webhook.
accessReview.webhookSecretHint: Write-only: it signs each post and is never shown again. Leave empty to keep the one held.
accessReview.webhookFailed: The scheduled review was not posted to the webhook: {{error}}
accessReview.webhookDelivered: This scheduled review was posted to the webhook.
accessReview.readOnly: Read-only: Provisa holds no grant to revoke
